outputs.summary: Implemented Workspace State Machine (Issue #3). Added WorkspaceStatus type with 7 states (CREATED, PREPARING, READY, RUNNING, WAIT_REVIEW, MERGED, CLEANED). Added LEGAL_TRANSITIONS map and transitionStatus() validator to src/core/workspace.ts that validates transitions, updates the DB, and records workspace_status_changed events. Updated createWorkspace to transition CREATED->PREPARING->READY. Updated bindRun to transition to RUNNING. Updated cleanupWorkspace to use transitionStatus for CLEANED. Decoupled lock.ts from workspace status (lock state tracked in workspace_locks table only). Updated DB schema default to 'CREATED'. CLI output already reflected status through formatWorkspace(). Build passes: typecheck + build + smoke test all green.

summary: Workspace State Machine implemented. 5 files changed. TypeScript typecheck, build, and smoke test all pass.
